CREATE TABLE players (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
, display_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT);
CREATE TABLE matches (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
        stage IN ('league', 'semifinal', 'third_place', 'final')
    ),
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    day TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    white_player_id INTEGER REFERENCES players(id),
    black_player_id INTEGER REFERENCES players(id),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled' CHECK (
        status IN (
            'scheduled', 'white_win', 'black_win', 'draw',
            'not_played', 'postponed'
        )
    ),
    series_game INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    best_of INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    manual_participants INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, match_number INTEGER, round_name TEXT, result TEXT, scheduled_time TEXT, note TEXT, is_next_match INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CHECK (white_player_id IS NULL OR black_player_id IS NULL
           OR white_player_id != black_player_id)
);
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    match_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id),
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    before_json TEXT,
    after_json TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_matches_stage_sequence
ON matches(stage, sequence);
CREATE TABLE tournament_settings (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    tournament_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    slogan TEXT NOT NULL,
    cadence TEXT NOT NULL,
    current_phase TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'league',
    champion_player_id INTEGER REFERENCES players(id),
    champion_manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    tournament_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started',
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, win_points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, draw_points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, loss_points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE TABLE login_attempts (
    ip TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    window_started INTEGER NOT NULL,
    locked_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX idx_matches_status
ON matches(status, sequence);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_matches_one_next
        ON matches(is_next_match) WHERE is_next_match = 1
        ;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_matches_match_number
        ON matches(match_number)
        ;
